title: Print price tags
text: Price Tags prints small labels with the product name, price, and barcode. It does not change the product itself.
steps: Click Products in the sidebar, then Price Tags.
Search for or scan a product to add it. Add it again to print one more label.
Set the number of copies to print. The box is beside the product.
Choose a layout in the middle and check the preview.
Click Print. The number on the button shows how many labels will print.

title: Label size and paper
text: Use the right panel to choose the paper type and set the size of each label.
steps: Click Products in the sidebar, then Price Tags.
In the right panel, choose a sheet or a roll.
Set how many labels fit across and set the width and height of each label in mm.
Turn each label part on or off, set the text size, and choose the barcode type.
Click Reset to return all settings to default. Your selected products stay in the list.

title: Labels print the wrong size
text: The browser print window can shrink or shift the page, which changes the label size.
steps: Click Print on the Price Tags page.
In the print window, set Margins to None or Default.
Check the paper preview. Nothing should run onto the next page.
